card.name: Inside proper names and brand names
card.fires_on: Middle syllables of capitalized proper names, such as surnames, place names and a brand name, split into pieces. Typical cases are the 'ado' in Tirado or Hirado, 'ot' in Corot, and 'CAR' in RECARBRIO.

modes.label: Person and place names
modes.description: Name-internal pieces such as 'ado', 'ost' or 'ot' in surnames and place names in history or art texts.

modes.label: Brand name pieces
modes.description: The 'CAR' piece inside the drug brand name RECARBRIO in label text.

card.plain: It fires partway through uncommon capitalized names, such as an artist's surname or a drug brand name, before the name is finished.
